title: Page 5
lines: 果不其然——
“娘，我银子不够，你给我。”整修铺子要银子，她要做全京城最大的酒楼，让宾客盈门。
“不行，只能借给你。”她不是只有一个孩子，好东西和钱都给了小女儿，那对其他孩子并不公平。
“借？”赵若瑜一脸困惑，不过万两银子罢了，娘又不是没有，那对娘而言只是九牛一毛。
“对，还要写借据，我不收你利息，但你要按月还我本金，头半年可以先不还，第七个月起要开始还钱，超过四个月没还，我便要把铺子收回抵债。”不能让她越赔越多。
她惊喊道：“娘，没有银子怎么开铺子？”
徐氏气定神闲地抚抚无皱痕的裙摆。“那就是你要解决的事，做生意没那么简单，你要想着如何开起来，而不是能赚到多少银子，一步步踏实走，不要好高骛远……”
第二章 谁才是攒钱高手(1)
娘偏心，明明说姊姊银钱上有困难，她可以贴补一二，换成她却什么也没有，银子不白给还要写借据？
这是什么世道呀？亲母女也要算得这么清楚，不过手指头缝间漏下些碎渣而已，计较那么多干什么，娘的银子最后还不是要给她和姊姊当压箱银，早给晚给不都一样，还怕她亏了不成？
她赵若瑜可是来自二十一世纪，满脑子是赚钱的手段，随便把现代的经营法搬来照本宣科，还能不赚上几座金山银山吗？
娘真是太短视了，不晓得投资她这个来自未来的金手指，等她赚大钱了，她用金砖银块把娘的金库砸烂。
沉浸在发财梦中的赵若瑜，压根没想过要怎么弄银子来，装点她梦想中的大酒楼门面，一心只埋怨娘亲的厚此薄彼，宁可资助肯定赔钱的姊姊也不愿拿钱帮她——用借的不叫帮，还说什么钱还不出来要把铺子收回去，这也太小看她了，她是穿越女，做生意怎么可能会赔钱？
她从没想过东街的一间铺子就足以抵母亲给姊姊的铺子和庄子，自己还一次得了两间，到底谁吃亏了、谁占便宜一目了然，她只顾着不满母亲只给铺子不给银子，全无想过铺子要如何管理，掌勺的大厨和掌柜要上哪里找。
赵若瑜把一切想得太美好了，前一世活了二十三年的她是典型的哈日族，她脑子里所知的菜谱以日式居多，芥末、咖哩、味噌、番茄酱等调味料在大楚这里根本没有，百姓们也不习惯吃生食，她的东洋料理等同无用。
而中式菜系，说实在的她吃过不多，吃习惯外食的她一毕业就进入日商公司工作，跟着日本人老板四处应酬，她知道的料亭比中餐厅多，尝过的寿司多不可数，再高级的套餐也习以为常，反正老板买单。
可是真要她说出几道中菜的做法，身为厨房白痴的她只会摇头，穿越小说里的金手指并非人人适用，先决条件要先拥有某样得天独厚的技艺，否则别说让人惊艳，恐怕只会沦为一场笑话。
“二小姐，老夫人在看你了。”
比赵若瑜个头略高一点的丫头，朝自家主子身后的衣衫轻轻一扯，把走神的主子给唤回神。
赵若瑜甜甜朝祖母一笑，见祖母注意力从自己身上移开后，她忍不住跟自个儿的丫鬟抱怨起来。“初春，你说我娘为什么不给我银子？我有哪一点不如姊姊，就因为她傻不愣登的吗？”她越说越气愤，不甘心才智过人的自己，居然输给一个一整天不说话的傻子。
“夫人也没给大小姐银子，一碗水端平。”二小姐太容易钻牛角尖了，一不如意便会胡思乱想。
初春和初夏是赵若瑜身边的一等丫头，她院子里另有二等丫头四名，粗使丫头和婆子若干。
原本两姊妹身旁也各有一个管事嬷嬷，可是其中一个白天吃酒连累了另一个，所以两人各罚二十大板，目前都卧床养伤，两姊妹只好带着丫头进进出出，自个儿管自个儿。
“那是姊姊不要，要不然……”赵若瑜轻哼了一声，心里很不平，觉得娘亲的心偏向一边。
“二小姐，你也不想想大小姐那个傻的，真给她银子她也守不住铺子，大小姐有自知之明，索性不要，省得赔得太多无法交代。”初春把声音压得很低，怕被人听见。
听了丫鬟的话，赵若瑜想想也对，姊姊跟她相像的是面容，而非脑子，她一个拥有五千年知识的高材生会比不上古代土着？“居然要开米铺，太好笑了，她怕吃不饱吗？”
她此时嘲笑米铺不起眼，是赚不了钱的行业，殊不知在若干年后，赵若瑾的米行将开遍大楚每一个角落，它成了大楚最大的米仓。
“二小姐，你先别说大小姐傻，夫人给了你两间铺子，咱们手头上的银两根本连装修费也付不起。”管银匣子的初夏比较务实，她知道自家小姐手上存银不多，小声地提醒她要赚钱前得先找到银子当资本，否则一切都沦为空谈。
“我连五百两也没有？”赵若瑜后知后觉地想到手头上的银钱花得差不多了，一个月二十两的月银实在不够她花用。
她和双生姊姊的性情截然不同，她非常爱花钱，看到喜欢的东西就一定要买下，即使她今年才七岁，可是她两世的年纪加起来也有三十岁了，看到好看的首饰珠钗，很难不心动。
在银子上没节制的她就宛如现代的购物狂，不管用不用得上，先买了再说，若是钱不够用就向爹娘撒撒娇，或是跟祖母要，在这短短的几年间她真的被宠坏了，养成予取予求的个性，才女的名头蒙蔽了她双眼，她真以为靠着剽窃别人的诗句能混一辈子，低估了古代原住民的智慧。
“二小姐，你只剩下五十七两又三十五个铜板。”在平常人家可以吃三年，但对二小姐而言只够买半根簪子。
“什么，这么少？”她大惊，不敢相信自己是穷光蛋。
“二小姐，要不跟大小姐借？”如果二小姐像大小姐一样只喜欢看书，就能省下不少银子。
赵若瑜不屑地一哼，“她有银子？”她是完全看不起自家的傻姊姊，她那么聪明都留不住银子，一个只会发呆的傻子，哪有可能比她有钱。
以己度人，她认为赵若瑾的银子早被底下的丫头、婆子给挖光了，主子脑子有病，做下人的还不趁机混水摸鱼，说不定赵若瑾连自己的月银有多少都不晓得，还没到她手里就被分光了。
同胞妹妹都看不起血浓于水的亲姊姊，可见赵若瑾把自己隐藏得有多深，但她只是闲得发慌不想理人罢了，有时托着腮帮子望天发呆，不说话也能被当成傻子？真是无言以对。
“奴婢听软玉说过，大小姐的银子很少花出去，她都存下来了，少说有好几千两。”保守的估算。
赵若瑜一听，一双杏眼忽地瞠大。“怎么可能？！”
怕主子责骂的初春避重就轻道：“大小姐很少出门，她不是在练字便是看书，闲暇时做做女红、刺绣，哪有机会花到钱，管银钱的温香又是个忠心的，听说大小姐的银子只进不出，一年一年的积累，只多不少。”
“大姊居然比我还有钱……”一想到自己揽钱的本事不如人，自以为事事高人一等的赵若瑜伤了自尊，她脸色有些臭。
在老侯爷、老太君所居住的承恩堂里，两房的媳妇和孙辈都来了，大房坐在右手边，分别是徐氏，长子赵永湛、次子赵永真，孙女儿坐下首，嫡长为前，次女在后。
content_en:
As expected——
"Mom, I don't have enough money, give it to me." She needs money to renovate the shop. She wants to build the largest restaurant in the capital, so that it can be filled with guests.
"No, I can only lend it to you." She didn't just have one child. All the good things and money were given to her younger daughter, which was unfair to the other children.
"Borrow it?" Zhao Ruoyu looked confused, but it was only ten thousand taels of silver, and it's not like my mother didn't have it. To her, it was just a drop in the bucket.
"Yes, I still need to write an IOU. I won't charge you interest, but you have to repay my principal monthly. You don't have to pay back the first half of the year. You have to start paying back from the seventh month. If you don't pay back for more than four months, I will take the shop back to pay off the debt." She can't let her pay more and more.
She exclaimed: "Mom, how can I open a shop without money?"
Mrs. Xu calmly stroked the wrinkle-free hem of her skirt. "That's what you have to solve. Doing business is not that simple. You have to think about how to start it, not how much money you can make. Take it step by step and don't be too ambitious..."
Chapter 2 Who is the master of saving money (1)
My mother is partial. She clearly said that her sister was in trouble with money and she could help her a little. But in her place, she got nothing. She didn’t give her the money for free but she still had to write an IOU?
What kind of world is this? Mother and daughter have to calculate so clearly, but it's just a few crumbs leaking between their fingers. Why worry about so much? In the end, my mother's money will be used as banknotes for her and her sister.
She, Zhao Ruoyu, comes from the 21st century, and her mind is full of ways to make money. If she just applies modern business methods and copy them from the book, can she not make a few gold and silver mountains?
My mother was so short-sighted that she didn't know how to invest in her golden finger from the future. When she made a lot of money, she smashed my mother's treasury with gold bricks and silver nuggets.
Zhao Ruoyu, who was immersed in the dream of getting rich, never thought about how to get money to decorate the facade of the big restaurant in her dream. She only complained about her mother's favoritism. She would rather support her sister who would definitely lose money than help her with money - borrowing money is not called help, and she said that the shop would be taken back if the money is not paid. This is too underestimated. She is a time-travelling woman, how can she lose money in business?
She never thought that one shop on East Street was enough to equal the shop and village her mother gave to her sister. She even got two at once. It was clear who suffered and who took advantage. She only cared about being dissatisfied with her mother for only giving the shop but not money. She never thought about how to manage the shop or where to find the chef and shopkeeper.
Zhao Ruoyu thought everything was too wonderful. She lived for twenty-three years in her previous life and was a typical Hari tribe. Most of the recipes she knew in her mind were Japanese. Seasonings such as mustard, curry, miso, and ketchup were not available in Dachu. The people were not used to eating raw food, so her Oriental cuisine was useless.
As for Chinese cuisine, to be honest, she had not eaten much. She was used to eating out and worked in a Japanese company as soon as she graduated. She socialized with the Japanese boss. She knew more ryokan than Chinese restaurants and had tasted countless sushi. No matter how high-end set meals were, she was used to it. Anyway, the boss paid the bill.
But if she were really asked to tell her how to make a few Chinese dishes, as a kitchen idiot, she would just shake her head. The golden finger in time travel novels is not suitable for everyone. The prerequisite is to have certain unique skills. Otherwise, let alone being amazing, it will just become a joke.
"Second Miss, the old lady is looking at you."
The girl, who was slightly taller than Zhao Ruoyu, gently pulled the clothes behind her master to bring her distracted master back to his senses.
Zhao Ruoyu smiled sweetly at her grandmother. After seeing her grandmother's attention diverted from her, she couldn't help but complain to her maid. "Chu Chun, why doesn't my mother give me money? I'm not as good as my sister in any way, just because she's stupid?" The more she spoke, the angrier she became, unwilling to accept that she, who was so smart, would lose to a fool who didn't speak all day long.
"My wife didn't give the eldest lady any money, so a bowl of water is just the same." The second lady is too easy to get into trouble, and will have random thoughts when she doesn't get what she wants.
Chuchun and Chuxia were the first-class maids around Zhao Ruoyu. There were four second-class maids in her yard, including several maids and mothers-in-law.
Originally, each of the two sisters had a nun in charge, but one of them drank alcohol during the day and hurt the other, so the two were fined twenty pieces each and are currently in bed recovering from injuries. The two sisters had no choice but to take the maid in and out and mind their own business.
"That's because my sister doesn't want it, otherwise..." Zhao Ruoyu snorted softly, feeling very unhappy and feeling that her mother's heart was leaning to one side.
"Second young lady, don't think about the stupid eldest lady. She won't be able to keep the shop even if you give her money. The eldest lady is self-aware and simply doesn't want it, so as not to pay too much and be unable to explain." Chuchun lowered her voice very low for fear of being heard.
After listening to the maid's words, Zhao Ruoyu thought about it rightly. What resembled her sister was her face, not her brain. Would she, a top student with five thousand years of knowledge, be inferior to the ancient aborigines? "It's so funny that they want to open a rice shop. Is she worried that she won't have enough to eat?"
At this time, she laughed at the inconspicuous rice shop, which was an industry that could not make money. Little did she know that in a few years, Zhao Ruojin's rice shop would open in every corner of Dachu, and it would become the largest rice warehouse in Dachu.
"Second young lady, please don't call the eldest lady stupid. My wife gave you two shops, and we can't even pay for the renovation with the silver on hand." Chu Xia, who was in charge of the silver box, was more pragmatic. She knew that her young lady didn't have much silver on hand, so she whispered to her that she had to find silver as capital before making money, otherwise everything would be empty talk.
"I don't even have five hundred taels?" Zhao Ruoyu realized that the money on hand was almost spent. Twenty taels a month was really not enough for her.
She is completely different from her twin sister in temperament. She loves spending money very much and will definitely buy something she likes when she sees it. Even though she is only seven years old this year, her age in her two lives combined is thirty years old. It is difficult not to be tempted when you see beautiful jewelry and hairpins.
She is like a modern shopaholic who has no restraint on money. She buys first regardless of whether she needs it or not. If the money is not enough, she will show off to her parents or ask her grandmother for it. In these few short years, she has been really spoiled and has developed a personality of asking for everything. The reputation of a talented woman blinded her eyes. She really thought that she could survive her whole life by plagiarizing other people's poems, and she underestimated the wisdom of ancient aborigines.
"Second Miss, you only have fifty-seven taels and thirty-five copper coins left." In ordinary people, this can last for three years, but for Second Miss, it is only enough to buy half a hairpin.
"What, so little?" She was shocked and couldn't believe that she was a pauper.
"Second young lady, why don't you borrow it from the eldest lady?" If the second young lady only likes reading like the eldest lady, she can save a lot of money.
Zhao Ruoyu snorted disdainfully, "She has money?" She looked down on her stupid sister completely. She was so smart that she couldn't keep the money. How could a fool who could only be in a daze have more money than her.
Using herself to save others, she thought that Zhao Ruojin's money had already been poached by the girls and women below. The master was mentally ill and the servants did not take advantage of troubled waters. Maybe Zhao Ruojin didn't even know how much money she had, and it was all divided before it came into her hands.
Compatriot sisters all look down on their biological sisters whose blood is thicker than water. This shows how deeply Zhao Ruojin hides herself, but she is just too idle to pay attention to others. Sometimes she holds her cheek and stares at the sky in a daze. How can she be regarded as a fool even if she doesn't speak? Really speechless.
"My servant heard from Ruanyu that the eldest lady rarely spends her money. She saves all of it, at least several thousand taels." A conservative estimate.
When Zhao Ruoyu heard this, her almond-shaped eyes suddenly widened. "How is that possible?!"
Chu Chun, who was afraid of being scolded by his master, said lightly: "The eldest lady seldom goes out. She is either practicing calligraphy or reading. In her free time, she does needlework and embroidery. How can she get the chance to spend money? Wen Xiang, who is in charge of money, is loyal. I heard that the eldest lady's money can only go in but not out. She only accumulates a lot more every year."
"Eldest sister actually has more money than me..." When she thought that her ability to collect money was inferior to others, Zhao Ruoyu, who thought she was superior in everything, had her self-esteem hurt, and her face turned a little foul.
In the Cheng'en Hall where the old marquis and old lady lived, the daughters-in-law and grandchildren of the two families came. The eldest daughter-in-law sat on the right, namely Mrs. Xu, the eldest son Zhao Yongzhan, and the second son Zhao Yongzhen. The granddaughter sat down, with the eldest daughter in front and the second daughter in the back.
